audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Sion Level 1 outright, called Level 2 a skill matchup, and gave Mordekaiser the 2+ item row. That contradicts the packet chart and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Neither champion can commit at level 1 (no dash on him, telegraphed charge on you), Death's Grasp into an isolated Obliterate is a real level-2 win, and at 2+ items a Heartsteel HP total plus Glory in Death makes the fight a coin flip — which is what a 49.97% win rate over 3044 games says.
audit.corrected: Rows 0/1/6 flipped to Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Realm of Death's cooldown was written as 110 seconds.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100. At level 6 the window you play around is 140 seconds, not 110 — that is a 30-second error in the single most important timer of the matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named Indestructible, and treated Mordekaiser's sustain as something bulk alone answers.
audit.why: Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s) banks damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume as a heal, so an extended Sion grind feeds it. Grievous Wounds decides those trades. Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s, 700 range) is the pull that sets up the isolated Obliterate (8/7/6/5/4s, 675 range) — staying outside 700 units is the whole early game.
audit.corrected: mid now names Indestructible and puts Grievous Wounds on the buy path.

audit.why: No verified patch movement to report for 26.15 on either kit.

edits.before: E-poke and W-shield trades cost him more than you. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Roar of the Slayer poke costs him more than it costs you, but neither of you can commit at level 1 — he has no dash, your Q is telegraphed.

edits.before: Charged Q from brush/fog is a half-HP knockup. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: His Death's Grasp pull into an isolated Obliterate wins level 2 — trade only with Soul Furnace already up.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 and particularly the moment Realm of Death unlocks are entirely his — he controls the pace of every duel and his Realm removes your team from the equation. Avoid fighting near minion waves he can E you into for the isolated Q bonus. At level 6 respect the Realm hard: if he presses R, your only winning moves inside are to immediately W-shield, land a charged Q stun to interrupt his Q follow-up, and survive long enough that your passive zombie form eats his remaining HP. Build Doran's Shield or a MR shard start and rush Heartsteel into a Hollow Radiance or Warmog's path so the Realm duel is at least contested rather than one-sided. Use your R to roam or re-engage ONLY when his Realm is on cooldown (110 seconds) — that is your actual window to play aggressive.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 and particularly the moment Realm of Death unlocks are entirely his — he controls the pace of every duel and his Realm removes your team from the equation. Stay outside the 700-range Death's Grasp so he never gets the isolated Obliterate bonus. At level 6 respect the Realm hard: if he presses R, your only winning moves inside are to immediately W-shield, land a charged Q stun to interrupt his Q follow-up, and survive long enough that your zombie form eats his remaining HP. Start Doran's Shield, rush Heartsteel, and get Grievous Wounds on the way — Indestructible turns every long grind into a heal, so anti-heal is what makes the Realm duel contestable. Re-engage ONLY when his Realm is down (140s at rank 1) — that is your actual window.

edits.before: His E pull into empowered Q isolated bonus is online at level 2; trade only with your W-shield up or you eat a chunky combo for nothing.
edits.after: Death's Grasp pull into an isolated Obliterate is online at level 2, and Obliterate is a 8s cooldown; trade only with Soul Furnace already up.

edits.before: Sustain through every trade with his W shield and in-realm healing so your zombie passive can't punish him
edits.after: Bank your chip damage into Indestructible and consume it as a heal, so a long grind refills him instead of you
